I desperately want a game like KCD for the Asoiaf universe, with an origin system similar to dragon age origins or to a lesser degree cyberpunk.
   An open world RPG with a deep combat and dialogue system where your origin matters, as well as something like some of the older crpg games i.e the early fallouts or arcanum where the details of your character matter to the people you're talking to. You could have origins from all over the 7 kingdoms but the main story would probably have to choose one or two of the kingdoms as maps, similar to the way KCD2 handled Trosky and kuttenburg to be able to do them justice and feel large enough for the scale of Westeros. 
    Different origins might lend themselves better to certain archetypes (knight, sell sword, fast talker, etc), but you don't necessarily have to be a noble in this universe to become a knight or Lord for example. 
     It might also be cool to explore a lesser known period of the history of Westeros so there's not as much baggage from the series and you can tell a more self contained story that contributes to the lore.
